title: The Dance No. 2
direction: Use the opening. A few deliberate drops with long decay, occasional paired events, and restrained force. Let the surface remain mostly open.

sections.name: suspended: opening
sections.note: Suspended harmonic notes return as soft marks and lighter measured echoes, with short phrase breaths. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
